prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: dark illustrated homepage hero, a single wide 3:2 landscape artwork with ample empty space on the LEFT for real HTML text to be added later. Do NOT render text.

Input image 1 is the definitive photographic reference for Jackie Leven's identity, facial anatomy, body, expression, pose and acoustic guitar. Input image 2 is ONLY the existing site's style and tonal reference, never a reference for pose or facial expression.

Draw Jackie in the same intimate live-performance moment as image 1, seated with his substantial natural build, slightly bowed head turned toward the viewer's left, lowered eyes, full soft cheeks, heavy chin, wavy swept-back greying hair. Preserve his unidealized likeness carefully. Preserve the position and anatomical plausibility of BOTH hands, playing the guitar, the guitar's rounded body and foreshortened neck. Loose open-neck shirt, rolled sleeves. Keep the small microphone near his mouth as a quiet simplified dark shape with a slender support line dissolving leftward. Omit lanyard, badge, cables, additional stands, amplifiers, chair details and the bright tent. No other person.

Composition: Jackie, his hands and guitar occupy the RIGHT 58–60% of the landscape canvas. Head around x=76%, y=27%. Figure large enough to show his face clearly, with his whole head, both hands and most of the guitar visible; leave breathing room at top and right. The LEFT 40–43% must be very dark, quiet negative space. Allow only a few faint broken brush traces from the musician to dissolve into the middle; no defined vertical boundary. He should seem suspended in an open dark space, not seated inside a depicted room. No floor or horizon. Avoid cropping hands or head. No mirroring of the photo.

Medium: expressive hand-drawn dry-brush ink and charcoal in the manner of input 2. Reduced broad tonal planes, irregular broken strokes, restrained texture, strong character with quiet warmth. Moderately abstract but faithful to this exact face. Retain natural asymmetries, age, weight and bowed posture. No beautification, slimming or heroic treatment. Face and hands are the clearest illuminated regions; guitar softly catches light; shirt, hair edges and lower torso break up and disappear into darkness. A drawing, not a photograph with an edge filter. Avoid intricate repetitive hatch patterns, plastic digitally smooth skin or shiny 3D rendering.

Palette: strictly neutral greys on almost-black anthracite #0d0f12, consistent with the existing site illustration. Mid-grey light planes, subdued luminous face and hands, no pure white, no cream, sepia, brown or blue cast. Background at every outer edge and across the entire left area seamlessly matches #0d0f12. Bottom of figure fades organically into background. No halo, spotlight cone, clouds, literal smoke, frame, typography, logo, watermark or decorative objects.

Deliver one landscape illustration, approximately 1536 by 1024. The main goal is recognisable Jackie from photo 1, freely floating in darkness, with painterly neutral ink mark-making and a gradual dissolve to empty dark space on the left.
